ctx.s: 商店街[しょうてんがい]が寂[さび]れていくのを{指[ゆび]をくわえて見[み]て}いられず、若者[わかもの]たちが立[た]ち上[あ]がった。
ctx.en: Unwilling to stand by as the shopping street declined, the young people took action.

bad.s: 面白[おもしろ]い映画[えいが]だったので、最後[さいご]まで{指[ゆび]をくわえて見[み]た}。
bad.en: (meant: the film was so good I watched it intently to the end)
bad.why: It means watching enviously and doing nothing, not watching with absorption. Say kuiiru you ni mita.

bad.s: 息子[むすこ]の発表[はっぴょう]を、私[わたし]は誇[ほこ]らしく{指[ゆび]をくわえて見[み]て}いた。
bad.en: (meant: I watched my son's presentation proudly)
bad.why: The phrase carries envy and helplessness, so it clashes with pride. Say hokorashiku mimamotte ita.

r: うしろゆびをさされる
mean: to be criticised behind one's back
lit: to have fingers pointed at one's back

use.how: Almost always passive, about conduct others would condemn: 後ろ指を指されるようなことはしていない, 後ろ指を指されない生き方.

near.diff: 白い目で見る is cold disapproval shown openly; 後ろ指を指される is being condemned in whispers behind your back.

cue: Your mother always told you to live so honestly that the neighbours would never have reason to whisper about you.

ctx.s: 人[ひと]に{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]される}ようなことは、何[なに]もしていません。
ctx.en: I have done nothing that anyone could whisper about.

ctx.s: 「そんなことをしたら、近所[きんじょ]で{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]される}よ。」
ctx.en: "If you do that, the neighbours will talk about you behind your back."

ctx.s: 母[はは]はいつも「{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]されない}生[い]き方[かた]をしなさい」と言[い]っていた。
ctx.en: My mother always said, "Live in such a way that no one can point a finger at you."

ctx.s: 不正[ふせい]が明[あき]らかになり、彼[かれ]は町中[まちじゅう]の人[ひと]から{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]される}ようになった。
ctx.en: Once the fraud came to light, the whole town began to talk about him behind his back.

ctx.s: 親[おや]の借金[しゃっきん]のせいで{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]された}子[こ]ども時代[じだい]を、彼女[かのじょ]は今[いま]も忘[わす]れない。
ctx.en: She still remembers a childhood of being whispered about because of her parents' debts.

ctx.s: 決[き]まりを守[まも]って堂々[どうどう]としていれば、{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]される}心配[しんぱい]はない。
ctx.en: If you follow the rules and stand tall, there's no need to worry about people talking behind your back.

bad.s: 道[みち]を聞[き]いたら、駅[えき]の方向[ほうこう]を{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]された}。
bad.en: (meant: when I asked the way, someone pointed behind me toward the station)
bad.why: It is never literal pointing. It means being condemned in gossip; for directions, say yubisashite oshiete kureta.

bad.s: 彼[かれ]はとても親切[しんせつ]なので、みんなに{後[うし]ろ指[ゆび]を指[さ]されて}いる。
bad.en: (meant: he is so kind that everyone speaks well of him)
bad.why: It is always condemnation, never praise. To be well spoken of is hyouban ga ii.
